rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese rendering for Sunday.

example.english: I usually stay home and rest on Sunday.
example.traditional: 星期日我通常留喺屋企休息。
example.jyutping: sing1 kei4 jat6 ngo5 tung1 soeng4 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 jau1 sik1

rows.note: Use this colloquial alternative for the same day of the week.

example.english: We go for dim sum together on Sunday.
example.traditional: 禮拜日我哋一齊去飲茶。
example.jyutping: lai5 baai3 jat6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 jam2 caa4
